newsitem.title: USA: US late spot LPGs stable, market seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: US late spot LPGs stable, market seeks direction.

text.p: U.S. late LPG prices were litlte changed late Wednesday from midday levels, although slightly firmer crude oil prices helped nudge Mont Belvieu propane higher.
Gulf Coast propane was offered at 35.50 cents a gallon, 0.25 cent firmer than Tuesday, as crude settled 14 cents a barrel higher.
Conway propane, meanwhile, was stable at 35.75 cents, with barrels trading earlier in the day for 35.62 cents.
"There hasn't been much direction for the past few days other than crude," one Midwest player said.

Trading on the New York Mercantile Exchange was exceptionally brisk, with 2,134 propane futures contracts traded Wednesday, including 2,062 for July delivery -- many times the normal daily futures volume.
